model_annotation: The image displays Figure 6, which consists of two line plots illustrating the training dynamics of the LLaMA-3.1-8B model on the Easy and Hard training sets. The top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set," and the bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set," both have "Steps" on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," is scaled from -1.2 to 1.2 with tick marks at intervals of 0.4. Each plot contains three lines: a solid blue line for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," a dashed red line for "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," and a dotted green line for "Llama-LUFFY-Hard." In the Easy Training Set plot, the blue line starts at a reward of approximately -0.8 and steadily increases to a peak of about 1.0 before slightly declining. The red line starts at a reward of approximately -0.6 and shows a similar increasing trend, reaching a peak of about 0.9. The green line starts at a reward of approximately -0.8 and increases to a peak of about 0.7. In the Hard Training Set plot, the blue line starts at a reward of approximately -0.8 and increases to a peak of about 0.9. The red line starts at a reward of approximately -0.6 and increases to a peak of about 0.7. The green line starts at a reward of approximately -0.8 and increases to a peak of about 0.5.
